# Send Alert

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Shows the user an alert.

## Syntax

~~~~text
alert(alert: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, title: <#String (Allows Variables) (Optional)#>, cancel: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
alert(alert: "Hello World!", title: "My First Jellycut", cancel: false)
~~~~
